description:
The Greek myDATA v2.0.0 and Digital Customer Base v1.1 provided by AADE are in a single dll. Get full control and support from myDATA, Delivery Notes and the Digital Customer Base. 
	It offers a number of simple tools that make creating apps that support myDATA and Digital Customer Base simple and quick.
releaseNotes:
A The class "DeliveryNote" has been added.
	
	B. MellonGroupPos and VivaWalletPos Class
	posTransaction Structure: The field PaymentType has been added
	transaction Structure: The field PaymentType has been added
	
	C. Class SendInvoices
	ProvidersSignature Structure: The field EndToΕndReferenceID has been added
	invoice Structure: The field TransportDetails marked as NOT VALID for v2.0.0 of myDATA and above.
	invoice Structure: packingsDeclarations field has been added.
	elements Structure: The field toWeigh has been added.
	invoiceLine Structure: The field movePurposeLine has been added.
	invoiceLine Structure: The field otherMovePurposeLineTitle has been added.
	The structure "packages" has been added.
	The method "newPackage" has been added.
	
	D. Class RequestInvoices
	Request method: The returned datatable now contains also the "downloadingInvoiceUrl" column. This used with "/PDF" in order to download the issued invoice as PDF. It will have value only if the corresponding invoice have been issued through an invoicing provider.
	Requesy method: The returned datatable now contains also the "qrCodeUrl" column. This URL refers to AADE's QR Code URL.
	invoice Structure: The field TransportDetails marked as NOT VALID for v2.0.0 of myDATA and above.
	invoice Structure: packingsDeclarations field has been added.
	invoice Structure: invoiceDeliveryStatus field has been added.
	invoice Structure: invoiceDeliveryEvents field has been added.
	invoice Structure: QRUrl field has been added.
	elements Structure: The field toWeigh has been added.
	invoiceLine Structure: The field movePurposeLine has been added.
	invoiceLine Structure: The field otherMovePurposeLineTitle has been added.
	
	E. myDATATools CLASS
	The method getPackagingType has been added.
    getInvoiceType method: New Invoice Types have been added (9.1, 9.2, 10.1, 10.2).
	The method getDeliveryOutcomeType method has been added.
	The method getInvoiceDeliveryStatus method has been added.
	
	F. Online Documentation
	- ADDED EXAMPLES FOR INVOICES 9.1, 9.2, 10.1, 10.2
	- ADDED A WHOLE NEW CHAPTER CALLED "DELIVERY NOTES"
